page: Microsoft Azure F32ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Fadsv7 family, powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V45 processor, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, it includes a 3780 GB NVMe SSD and is Premium Storage capable. It does not feature any GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations place the F32ads_v7 in the top tier for single-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 3541.18. It also registers top-tier performance in single-threaded gzip compression at 38.0 GB/sec, single-threaded bzip3 decompression at 16.54 GB/sec, and PassMark database operations at 37385.95. Multi-core performance is strong, ranking in the top 25% with a stress-ng multi-core score of 111314.11 and a PassMark CPU score of 72176.91. Memory bandwidth is robust, delivering 6116.97 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 214.06 GB/sec for large-block reads.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial 3780 GB local NVMe SSD storage, the F32ads_v7 offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring both compute power and fast local disk access. The instance is well-suited for database operations, web serving, and lightweight LLM inference, as demonstrated by its top-tier database benchmark results and strong text generation speeds on 7B models.

This configuration provides a balanced resource profile, making it highly suitable for database management, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference workloads.
